summary: A truck-mounted street sweeper on the cab-over truck chassis: a water tank and a taller crowned debris hopper… joints cab_tilt, door_l, door_r, broom_l, broom_r, hopper_door, …; options body, paint; sockets socket_driver, socket_tow, socket_broom_l, socket_broom_r, socket_pickup, socket_dump.
